verdict.gold_reason: Article 17(3) lets each balance responsible party change the schedules used to calculate its position before the intraday cross-zonal gate closure time. Article 17(4) allows only internal commercial schedules to be changed afterwards, under the rules in the Article 18 terms and conditions. Both points in the reference answer are supported.

other_articles.why: Article 18(6)(e) says the balance responsible party terms and conditions contain the rules for changing schedules before and after the intraday gate closure time, by reference to Article 17(3) and (4). It does not itself state the cut-off point.

verdict.ambiguity_reason: The question maps directly onto Article 17(3). Its wording ('freely') fits the contrast with the restricted changes after gate closure in Article 17(4).
